name: Balduran
backstory:
Balduran was a legendary sailor who returned from his adventures with vast wealth. He invested his wealth in a small coastal village known as Grey Harbour. Through his patronage, the village grew into the city today known as Baldur's Gate.

Balduran's legendary status gives rise to many tall tales. In Baldur's Gate 3, the party might hear mention of how he saved Baldur's Gate by driving away raiders upon his ship, the Wandering Eye, and how he sailed to the edge of the world.
